description: HTE-backed retrosynthetic template library. Contains hand-curated templates + high-quality extracted templates (source='extracted'). Each template applies AllChem.RunReactants() to generate validated precursor SMILES pairs.

templates.name: buchwald_hartwig
templates.description: Aryl amine / N-aryl heterocycle ← aryl bromide + amine/N-H heterocycle (Buchwald-Hartwig/Pd)

templates.name: snar_amination
templates.description: Aryl amine / N-aryl heterocycle ← electron-poor aryl fluoride + amine (SNAr)
templates.notes: Works best on electron-poor arenes (pyridines, nitro-aryls). Typically no metal catalyst needed. K2CO3 or Cs2CO3 base, DMSO solvent.

templates.name: chan_lam_n_arylation
templates.description: N-aryl amine ← arylboronic acid + secondary amine (Chan-Lam, Cu-catalysed)
templates.notes: Cu(OAc)2, pyridine or Et3N, open air or O2. Mild conditions, room temp. Secondary amines give better yields than primary.

templates.name: reductive_amination
templates.notes: NaBH(OAc)3 or NaBH3CN as reductant. pH 5–7 (AcOH). Works for primary and secondary amines. Steric hindrance on ketone reduces yield.

templates.name: urea_formation
templates.notes: The isocyanate fragment may be from CDI activation or phosgene-derived.

templates.name: gabriel_amine
templates.description: Primary amine ← alkyl bromide + phthalimide (Gabriel synthesis)

templates.name: suzuki_miyaura
templates.description: Biaryl bond ← aryl bromide + arylboronic acid (Suzuki)

templates.name: decarboxylative_arylation
templates.description: Aryl-alkyl bond ← aryl halide + carboxylic acid (decarboxylative)

templates.name: kumada_coupling
templates.description: Biaryl bond ← aryl halide + aryl Grignard (Kumada)

templates.name: giese_radical
templates.description: Radical addition product ← alkyl bromide + Michael acceptor (Giese)

templates.name: michael_addition
templates.description: Michael adduct ← carbon nucleophile (active methylene) + α,β-unsaturated carbonyl (Michael)
templates.notes: Nu must have acidic alpha-H (malonate, nitrile, beta-ketoester). Base catalyst (NaH, K2CO3, DBU). Solvent: THF or DMF.

templates.name: nozaki_hiyama_kishi
templates.description: Allylic alcohol ← aldehyde + vinyl halide (NHK, Cr/Ni)

templates.name: c_o_coupling_pd
templates.description: Aryl ether ← aryl bromide + alcohol (Pd-catalysed C–O coupling)

templates.name: mitsunobu_etherification
templates.description: Aryl ether ← phenol + alcohol with inversion (Mitsunobu)

templates.name: c_s_coupling
templates.description: Aryl thioether ← aryl bromide + thiol (Pd or Cu catalysed)
templates.notes: Pd(OAc)2/Xantphos or CuI/diamine. Base: Cs2CO3. Watch for disulfide oxidation.

templates.name: cuaac_triazole
templates.notes: CuI or Cu(OAc)2/sodium ascorbate. Water/t-BuOH or DMSO. Room temperature. Highly regioselective → 1,4-substituted triazole. Bioorthogonal.

templates.name: ketone_from_nabh4
templates.description: Secondary alcohol came from NaBH4 reduction of ketone
templates.notes: NaBH4 in MeOH/EtOH or THF. Selective for ketones over esters at −78 °C. For aldehydes, same conditions at 0 °C.

templates.name: aldehyde_from_nabh4
templates.description: Primary alcohol came from NaBH4 reduction of aldehyde
templates.notes: NaBH4 in MeOH/EtOH at 0 °C. Chemoselective for aldehydes at low temp.

templates.name: snar_co
templates.description: Aryl alkyl/aryl ether ← electron-poor aryl fluoride + alcohol (SNAr C-O)
templates.notes: Requires electron-poor arene (pyridines, nitroaryls, pyrimidines). Alkoxide or phenoxide nucleophile. K2CO3 or Cs2CO3, DMF/DMSO.

templates.name: ester_from_lah_reduction
templates.description: Primary/secondary alcohol came from LAH reduction of ester/acid
templates.notes: LiAlH4 in Et2O or THF at 0 °C. Not compatible with protic solvents. DIBAL-H at −78 °C can stop at aldehyde stage.

templates.name: deoxy_fluorination
templates.description: Alkyl fluoride came from deoxyfluorination of alcohol (DAST/Deoxofluor)
templates.notes: DAST or Deoxofluor in DCM, −78 °C → RT. Inverts configuration at secondary C. Not compatible with acid-sensitive groups. Watch for elimination side products.

templates.name: electrophilic_fluorination
templates.description: Aryl fluoride came from electrophilic fluorination of arene (Selectfluor)
templates.notes: Selectfluor or NFSI. Directed by electron-rich arenes. Regioselectivity can be challenging without directing group.

templates.name: sandmeyer_bromide
templates.description: Aryl bromide came from Sandmeyer reaction on ArNH2 via diazonium
templates.notes: NaNO2/HBr then CuBr. Requires aniline precursor. Reaction via diazonium salt at 0–5 °C.

templates.name: balz_schiemann
templates.description: Aryl fluoride came from Balz-Schiemann (ArNH2 → ArF via diazonium BF4)

templates.name: trifluoromethylation
templates.description: Aryl-CF3 ← aryl bromide (Cu-mediated or Togni reagent)

templates.name: aldehyde_from_oxidation
templates.description: Aldehyde came from oxidation of primary alcohol (DMP/Swern/IBX)

templates.name: ketone_from_oxidation
templates.description: Ketone came from oxidation of secondary alcohol

templates.name: carbamate_formation
templates.notes: Use simpler 2-fragment template for amine + chloroformate: [NX3:1][C:2](=O)[OX2:3]>>[N:1].[C:2](=O)Cl

templates.name: wacker_oxidation
templates.description: Methyl ketone ← terminal alkene (Wacker oxidation, Pd/Cu)

templates.name: diazotransfer_azide
templates.description: Alkyl azide came from diazotransfer on primary amine
